# Per-Attribute Scaling ("+X per N Strength/Dexterity/Intelligence")

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Mechanic tags:** breakpoint, condition, step-function

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped in the engine; not yet verified in-game. floor(attribute_total / divisor) x per-unit value, optionally clamped to a cap. Divisor/cap may themselves roll as a (a-b) range in the source data (e.g. Royal Cycle's "per (10-12) Strength") - collapsed to the midpoint, mirroring mod_parser's existing range-collapse convention. Covers 8 core-talent lines (Fire Damage/Minion Fire Damage per 12 Str, Max Life per 5 Str, Armor per 24 Str, Evasion per 24 Dex, Attack+Cast Speed per 40 Dex, Max ES per 5 Int, Mana per 6 Int) and the per-attribute lines on Royal Cycle, Last Words of Chaos, Ralph's Journey, and Magnus' Scar. Combined with the attribute-scaled-added-damage and main-stat-damage-bonus-override entries, all 6 named legendary items now resolve to full coverage.
